title: Evaluation History Log Entry
description: One entry per 4D evaluation verdict detected. Written by enforce-4d-evaluation.js (Stop hook) to .claude/memory/evaluation-history.jsonl. Used for long-term quality trend analysis and session retrospectives.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Written at Stop hook time, not at evaluation time — may lag actual evaluation by the remainder of the session.

sessionId.description: Session ID from context.json skillTracking.sessionId or lastSessionId. May be 'unknown' if context.json is unavailable or stale.

taskHash.description: 12-char hex prefix of SHA256(prompt[0:200]). Sourced from delegation.jsonl via detectTaskFromDelegationLog() — uses the most recent taskHash in the session window. Null if no delegation log data exists. Join to delegation.jsonl completion entry with matching taskHash to correlate verdict with task dispatch.

agentUsed.description: Agent identifier extracted from context around the VERDICT match. May be null if extraction failed or verdict appeared without clear agent attribution.

taskType.description: Task type extracted from context around the VERDICT match. Heuristic extraction — may be null or imprecise.

verdict.description: Normalized verdict string from VERDICT: pattern match in conversation context.

iterationCount.description: Number of refinement iterations for this task. Extracted from context if available, null if not determinable. Post-v1 circuit breaker: hard limit of 3.

coachingApplied.description: Whether coaching/refinement instructions were provided with a NEEDS REFINEMENT verdict. Null if not determinable from context.

consumers: enforce-4d-evaluation.js — writes this log via logEvaluationHistory()
reflector agent — reads evaluation-history.jsonl for session retrospectives and CLAUDE.md improvement proposals
diary-writer agent — may reference for episodic memory capture
knownLimitations: timestamp is Stop hook time, not evaluation time — multiple verdicts from same session share similar timestamps
agentUsed and taskType are heuristic extractions from regex context windows — accuracy not guaranteed
iterationCount extraction is context-dependent — null is common for sessions predating the circuit breaker
location: .claude/memory/ not .claude/logs/ — different directory from other two log files

taskHash uses the most recent hash in the session window — for sessions with multiple delegations, all verdicts get the same hash (the last one). True per-verdict correlation requires matching taskHash + timestamp proximity.
taskHash correlation uses the most recent delegation log entry in the window — in parallel dispatch scenarios with multiple agents, this may match the wrong delegation entry.
